breakdown.reasoning: The specification replaces the gravity-only formula P = ρgh with the rotating-fluid equilibrium equation dP/dr = ρrω² and correctly integrates it to P(r) = P₀ + ½ρω²r². It also explicitly rejects using the static formula for this radial pressure distribution.

The specification uses centrifugal acceleration rω², rather than gravitational acceleration g, to determine the pressure distribution and correctly converts 10,000 RPM to approximately 1047.2 rad/s. This implements the centrifugal-dominated model required by the ground truth.
